answer: A per-identity stake bond prices every extra identity. Each agent lockup is slashed if proven fake, and reputation cannot be copied to siblings, so a farm of N identities needs N stakes held for N lockups. Marginal cost per fake stays constant while expected loss grows linearly, and one detection burns the whole stake. Honest newcomers start on a cheap tier that grows with history, so a real garden spreads on its own trellis without paying for echo identities.
